messages:
Noah Kim: CloudFuse says some customers saw credits on Mar 12 instead of Mar 11 after they flipped to daily rollups. Can team check?
Sofia Alvarez: Looks like rollups omit window_start/window_end and include local_date=2025-03-12; exporter tz=America/Los_Angeles -> UTC shift caused date bump.
Ibrahim Khan: marketplace-bot logs show per-hour events already applied for Mar 11; rollup arrived later and overlapped -> some customers got double credits.
marketplace-bot: webhook accepted rollup cloudfuse at 2025-03-13T05:20:11Z (no window_start).
Noah Kim: Ops: pause auto-accept for CloudFuse rollups until we verify.
cloudfuse-bot: Pausing now. We'll produce a revoke file with source_event_ids and rollup_id. ETA 2025-03-13T18:00Z.
Sofia Alvarez: Eng: add validation to require window_start/window_end and exporter_timezone header. Also add a temporary guard: if hourly events exist for window and rollup has null rollup_id -> mark as suspect.
Ibrahim Khan: I'll run a ledger diff for Mar 11-12 and share affected accounts.
Billing Ops: Holding credit notifications for impacted accounts.
Noah Kim: Customer comms draft: "We're reviewing unexpected credits from a partner export; reconciliation in progress; no action required."
cloudfuse-bot: Revokes uploaded: s3://cloudfuse-revokes/2025-03-13/revokes-2025-03-11.json (sent to eng@redwood).
Ibrahim Khan: Diff result: 289 duplicate entries across 96 customers, total duplicated tokens 198,720. Will apply automated reversals where source_event_ids match.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll add contract addendum to require rollup_id/source_batch_ids and explicit exporter_timezone. Legal please review.
Legal: Reviewing clause.
Noah Kim: Thanks team. Hold ingestion until revokes processed and tests pass. End thread.
